project: HM Land Registry public-estate OKF Bundle
release_authority: This policy review permits candidate generation only. It does not approve publication. Exact-digest G3 evidence, independent review and the project-owner G9 decision remain external release evidence.

review_method.decision_scope: Metadata-only policy controls and the explicit record-level rights classifications applied to the v0.3.0 AI-generated proof-of-concept candidate; legislation.gov.uk and National Data Library reuse notices were rechecked on 10 August 2026, while G3 evidence, independent review and any owner approval must bind the exact candidate digest.

scope: Public metadata acquisition and static metadata publication only.
default_rule: Unknown rights, access or source-layer classification fail closed and require human review.
field_semantics: collection_allowed and publication_allowed apply to the assessed source-content layer. When either is false, allowed_fields is a narrow public-metadata exception and does not authorise service operation or source-content reuse.

assessments.layer: GOV.UK and HM Land Registry page metadata
assessments.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0, subject to source exceptions
assessments.attribution: Retain source publisher and route and provide OGL attribution.
assessments.review_trigger: Page exception, attachment, source-field expansion or OGL change.

assessments.layer: HM Land Registry dataset metadata and distributions
assessments.licence: Per dataset and distribution; no bundle-wide source-data licence.
assessments.attribution: Preserve exact publisher-specified HM Land Registry, Ordnance Survey, Royal Mail, GeoPlace or other attribution.
assessments.review_trigger: New dataset/distribution, sample publication, access change, licence change or third-party field.

assessments.layer: Property information, Local Land Charges, portal and Business Gateway services
assessments.review_trigger: Any proposal to call a service or collect fields beyond public descriptions.

assessments.layer: HM Land Registry public GitHub repository metadata
assessments.licence: Per repository; missing licence means no code-reuse assumption.
assessments.attribution: Retain organisation, repository URL and declared licence identifier.
assessments.review_trigger: Field expansion beyond repository metadata or source-code redistribution.

assessments.layer: Central Digital and Data Office API Catalogue metadata
assessments.licence: Catalogue repository terms and per-service terms.
assessments.attribution: Attribute the catalogue and preserve the publisher-operated HMLR authority link.
assessments.review_trigger: Catalogue licence change or operational claim based on catalogue-only evidence.

assessments.layer: Legislation.gov.uk public legislation metadata and content references
prohibited_content: EU-derived content without its applicable reuse terms
assessments.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated; separately identified EU-derived material retains its stated reuse terms.
assessments.attribution: Retain legislation.gov.uk, the legislation identifier and the applicable Crown copyright and reuse notice.
assessments.review_trigger: Any source-content reproduction, legal interpretation, legislation format expansion or change to the displayed reuse notice.

assessments.layer: National Data Library collection-page and catalogue metadata
prohibited_content: source-specific rights inherited from catalogue membership
assessments.licence: National Data Library page content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated; linked datasets retain their publisher terms.
assessments.attribution: Attribute the National Data Library collection page and preserve each linked publisher route and licence separately.
assessments.review_trigger: Catalogue terms change, linked-dataset reuse, field expansion or an operational claim based on catalogue-only evidence.

assessments.layer: HM Land Registry fee-calculator service operation and generated output
assessments.licence: Service and output reuse rights not established; no source-content or result-reuse permission is inferred from public access.
assessments.attribution: Retain HM Land Registry and the official calculator route; label any reference as metadata-only.
assessments.review_trigger: Any calculator execution, output retention, content reuse, terms discovery or change to the public service route.

assessments.licence: CC BY 4.0 for original receipt metadata; underlying sources retain their own terms.
assessments.attribution: HM Land Registry public-estate OKF Bundle contributors, version and canonical release URL.
assessments.review_trigger: Receipt field expansion, source-body capture or a change to project-content licensing.

assessments.layer: Property, register, help-forum and user-submitted personal information
allowed_fields: top-level public help and privacy route metadata
assessments.review_trigger: Any personal-data discovery or proposal to include user- or property-level content.

release_checks: Every public record resolves to exactly one current primary rights assessment, plus only explicitly governed additional constraints where applicable.
Every record has explicit access and rights states; unknown fails closed.
Allowlisted public fields only are present.
No credentials, certificates, tokens, signed URLs or personal-level records are present.
Required source and third-party attribution is visible.
A reviewer samples every adapter and all error/outlier buckets.
The completed review binds the exact candidate digest.
open_items: No independent human legal or licence audit has been completed; retain this limitation as release residual RISK-015.
Live rights, terms and privacy page bodies are not archived in the repository; revalidate publisher-operated routes for every later release.
Dataset and repository rights remain per-source and volatile; this policy review does not authorise source-data or source-code redistribution.
Field-inventory, safety-scan and independent rights receipts must bind the exact v0.3.0 candidate digest; version-scoped evidence records their authoritative state and any publication authority.
